notes:
Lead: inbound signup from product Hunt embed. Using Hosted API for concierge chat in hospitality booking flow. Early discovery call 2026-03-03. Primary pain: perceived latency spikes during peak booking windows (18:00-22:00 PST) — customers report response time 700ms-1.8s which feels slow for live chat. Client lib is in Node.js, single-threaded process that pins requests to us-west region; no region failover. They have default client timeout 60s, but front-end sets a 3s request timeout leading to visible truncated responses and multiple retries — exacerbates load.

What we know / requirements:
- Workload: low-concurrency chat (100-300 users concurrently during peaks), occasional embeddings for search re-rank (background jobs).
- Latency target: p95 < 700ms for short prompts (<120 tokens). Cost sensitivity: high (SMB budget), prefer hosted metered usage.
- Model: prefer smaller 8B-ish open models but will accept Redwood verified defaults; want fallback to cheaper variant during load.
- Security: SOC2 required, SSO later; currently ok with public cloud.

Recent interactions:
- 2026-03-03 discovery call (Fireflies ff_20260303_9b2e) demo of Hosted API; AE walked through quickstart. SE reviewed client stack and found region hardcoding.
- 2026-03-05 received Gmail thread with logs (thread-12345abc) showing spikes correlated with EU traffic routing through us-west due to DNS TTL.
- 2026-03-08 small POC: switched to streaming -> frontend accepted partial tokens but client timeout still caused aborted streams.
- 2026-03-10 Redwood support opened REDW-1028 to investigate 502s during retries; found client retries set to exponential backoff with 3 immediate retries.

Perf tuning recommendations given to client (notes captured in call):
- Region strategy: set region-aware DNS + allow client to prefer nearest region (suggest na-east or eu-west depending on user geography); do A/B test for 48h (tell them to use drive://pricing-and-regions-smb-playbook for region selection heuristics).
- Timeouts: recommend front-end request timeout 8-10s for streaming endpoints (so partial content renders) and client SDK socket timeout 30s; disable aggressive immediate retries in the browser (leave 1 retry with jitter).
- Prompt guidance: trim system and user message boilerplate, move long documents to embeddings + retrieval for context; aim for <120 user tokens for interactive chat to keep p95 in budget.
- Streaming: enable streaming for chat to improve perceived latency; ensure front-end consumes chunks and doesn't close connection on first small gap.
- Batching/caching: use session-level prefix caching for repeated queries (booking templates) to save token cost and reduce server load.
- Model fallbacks: configure policy to route to cheaper 8B variant at >85% CPU utilization on default model; Redwood can auto-fallback if capacity low.

Open items / blockers:
- Engineering to add region ping and fallback logic (client change) — they estimate 2 dev days.
- Product asks for written step-by-step perf checklist and code snippets for Node SDK (AE to send).
- Pricing concerns — need clear estimate of monthly spend at 200 concurrent users before commit.
